messages:
Hannah (Product): Quick one  corporate card declined during a week-long Euro rail pass purchase (booking REF RAIL-772) so I paid with my personal card. I also bought a 1st-class upgrade on one leg for comfort during an overnight (company policy prefers coach unless approved). Receipt is a single PDF for the pass + upgrade total EUR 345. Can I get reimbursed for the coach portion only and the upgrade? Also Tom is on parental leave until next Wed  who can approve an exception for the upgrade?

Keisha (People Ops): Short: we reimburse business transportation at the lowest reasonable class (coach). First-class upgrades are reimbursable only with prior manager approval or for documented medical/operational reasons. Since Tom is OOO, you can request temporary delegation.

Marco (Finance): Add: we need the vendor invoice (PDF) and a bank statement line showing the charge. If the invoice lumps everything, Finance will prorate the base rail fare vs upgrade by asking the vendor for a price breakdown or by using standard fare tables for that route. If you can't get vendor breakdown, we ask you to estimate upgrade cost and provide a brief justification.

Hannah (Product): I tried vendor support but they say price is bundled. Estimated upgrade is ~EUR 55 for that leg. I have the booking confirmation showing class code `1` for that leg and coach for others. Tom gave verbal sign-off before leave but didn't write it down.

Keisha (People Ops): Process: 1) Upload the PDF receipt + booking confirmation to Expensify. 2) In the expense description write: "rail pass bundled; estimated upgrade EUR 55; manager verbal approval noted". 3) Email finance-approvals@redwood.com with the expense link and CC people-ops for delegation approval. We can fast-track up to EUR 500 for urgent travel reimbursements.

Marco (Finance): We'll accept manager verbal approval only if a delegate signs-off via finance-approvals email and Tom confirms on his return (we'll keep the audit trail). VAT: rail tickets in EU are generally non-recoverable; no VAT reclaim needed.

Tom (Manager): Back-up approval: I confirm Hannah's upgrade was pre-approved verbally due to overnight shift coverage. I delegate approval to Keisha to sign on my behalf for this expense. Approving coach fare + reimbursement of upgrade as a discretionary one-time exception.

Expense Bot: Reminder  submit within 30 days. Required uploads: ticket/booking PDF, bank stmt screenshot, manager delegation email. Use tags: `rail`, `class-upgrade`, `delegation`. Help: https://redwood.example/docs/expenses#rail-upgrades

Hannah (Product): Thanks all  uploaded files and sent the delegation email. Tagging Keisha for approval.
